items.t: Curis (CRIS) Stock Fair Value Falls After Q3 And Private Placement Rework
items.sum: Curis is back in focus after Street price targets reset sharply, with some shifting from US$20 to around US$5 and others from US$43 to about US$6. Analysts link these moves to updated models after the Q3 report and the impact of the October private placement, which changed how they frame dilution, funding, and execution risk rather than their overall view of the business.
